cards.rules: Never have I ever fallen asleep on a beach and burned. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Point and Pray
cards.rules: Never have I ever ordered abroad by pointing and regretted it. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Wrong Bed
cards.rules: Never have I ever woken up in the wrong hotel room. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Left on Read
cards.rules: Never have I ever left someone on read for a week. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Location Shared
cards.rules: Never have I ever tracked someone's location in secret. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Drafts Folder
cards.rules: Never have I ever rewritten a text ten times and never sent it. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Ego Search
cards.rules: Never have I ever googled myself this month. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Screen Time
cards.rules: Never have I ever hit eight hours of screen time in a day. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Wrong Tab
cards.rules: Never have I ever shared my screen with the wrong tab open. Anyone who has drinks 3.

cards.title: Keyboard Warrior
cards.rules: Never have I ever argued with a stranger online for an hour. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Untagged
cards.rules: Never have I ever untagged myself from every photo of a night. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Venmo Ghost
cards.rules: Never have I ever never paid a friend back. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Split It Evenly
cards.rules: Never have I ever ordered the most and asked to split evenly. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Overdraft
cards.rules: Never have I ever overdrawn my account on a night out. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Tags Still On
cards.rules: Never have I ever worn something once and returned it. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Price Inflation
cards.rules: Never have I ever lied about how much something cost. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Baby Voice
cards.rules: Never have I ever used a baby voice on an adult. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Parked and Crying
cards.rules: Never have I ever cried in a parked car. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Sleepwalker
cards.rules: Never have I ever woken up somewhere I fell asleep walking. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Breakup Haircut
cards.rules: Never have I ever cut my own hair after a breakup. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: One Brow
cards.rules: Never have I ever shaved off an eyebrow. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Rabbit Hole
cards.rules: Never have I ever believed a conspiracy theory for a whole week. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Wrong Party
cards.rules: Never have I ever crashed the wrong party and stayed. Anyone who has drinks 2. Tell it.

cards.title: Lights Out at Nine
cards.rules: Never have I ever gone to bed before nine on a Saturday. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Chipped
cards.rules: Never have I ever chipped a tooth on a bottle. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Singed
cards.rules: Never have I ever set my own hair on fire. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Talking to Plants
cards.rules: Never have I ever named a houseplant and talked to it. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Ugly Crier
cards.rules: Never have I ever cried at a commercial. Anyone who has drinks 2.

cards.title: Five Fingers
cards.rules: Three fingers up. Clockwise, say a never have I ever; fold if you have. First fist drinks 3.

cards.title: Speed Round
cards.rules: Clockwise, fast: a never have I ever each. Anyone who has drinks 1. Stall: drink 2.

cards.title: Lone Wolf
cards.rules: Say a never have I ever only you've done. Nobody else has: give 4. Someone has: drink 2.

cards.title: Lie Detector
cards.rules: Say a never have I ever you HAVE done. Caught lying: drink 3. Got away with it: give 3.

cards.title: Called Out
cards.rules: Aim a never have I ever at your left neighbor. If they have, they drink 3. If not, you do.

cards.title: Hot Seat
cards.rules: Everyone asks you one never have I ever. Drink 1 for each you've done.

cards.title: Clean Record
cards.rules: Never have I ever done anything on these cards. Anyone who can say that honestly gives 3.

cards.title: Thrown Out
cards.rules: Never have I ever been thrown out of somewhere. Anyone who has drinks the roll.

cards.title: Still Drunk
cards.rules: Never have I ever woken up still drunk. Anyone who has drinks the roll.

cards.title: Pressed Send
cards.rules: Never have I ever sent a nude. Anyone who has drinks the roll.

cards.title: Flip Side
cards.rules: Never have I ever been dumped. Flip the coin to see who drinks.

outcomes.instruction: Tails. Anyone who's been dumped drinks 2.
Heads. Anyone who did the dumping drinks 2.

cards.title: Honest Liars
cards.rules: Never have I ever lied during this game. Flip the coin.

outcomes.instruction: Tails. Anyone who hasn't drinks 2. Sure you haven't.

cards.title: Call It
cards.rules: Never have I ever cheated at a coin toss. Everyone calls heads or tails, then flip.

outcomes.instruction: Tails. Everyone who called heads drinks 2.
Heads. Everyone who called tails drinks 2.

cards.title: Double Life
cards.rules: Never have I ever kept a secret from this whole table. Flip the coin.

outcomes.instruction: Heads. Anyone who hasn't drinks 1. Boring.

cards.title: Confessional
cards.rules: Name the worst thing you did this year. Then flip the coin.

outcomes.instruction: Tails. Tell the whole story, then drink 2.
Heads. Your secret's safe. Everyone else drinks 1.

cards.title: Last Word
cards.rules: Never have I ever ended a night sober. Flip the coin.

outcomes.instruction: Heads. Anyone who has finishes theirs.
